unresolved.reason: CUSA-07919 appears in the current RegionAtlas Spain page and as an A Way Out title ID in SerialStation, but SerialStation's physical-disc list only shows CUSA-07995 and CUSA-08004. No source found ties CUSA-07919 to the Spanish physical release; Spanish physical evidence instead points to CUSA-08004.
GameFAQs lists Japan as TBA without barcode or product code; no confirmed Japanese physical PS4 SKU was located.

No confirmed Collector's, Limited, Steelbook, Promo, Press, Review or Not For Resale physical PS4 edition was located in the sources searched. This is negative search evidence, not proof of nonexistence.

EA Spain stated before launch that only PS4 physical distribution was confirmed in Spain while Xbox One physical distribution was still being studied. A later Spain-specific Xbox One barcode/packaging SKU was not confirmed in this research; generic/french-polish European physical SKUs do exist.
GameFAQs lists Japan as TBA without barcode or product code; no confirmed Japanese physical Xbox One SKU was located.

The Xbox store lists the Xbox One title as playable on Xbox Series X|S, but no separate native Xbox Series physical or digital release was identified. Do not treat backward compatibility as a distinct Xbox Series release.

coveredQueueEntries.reason: The PS4 trigger entry was researched across the physical regional variants located in authoritative/retail/preservation sources, including Spain, UK, French/Dutch EU, Germany, Poland, Switzerland, Nordic, Australia, US, Canada, Brazil and Asia; remaining Japan/special-edition questions are explicitly recorded as unresolved rather than silently inferred.
